status: rigorous real-zero-band homotopy and published-sector composition theorem

kernel.far_tail: all required moments on u>=2 are enclosed by symmetric radius 1e-800

far_tail_audit.derivative_rule: the exponent derivative is below -1 for u>=2

exact.horizontal_boundary: For t>0, Theorem 3.2 gives |Im z|<=sqrt(1-2t)<1. At t=0, H_0(z)=xi((1+iz)/2)/8 and xi has no zeros on Re s=0 or Re s=1.

homotopy.top_time: Lambda<=1/5 implies every H_(1/5) zero is real
homotopy.argument: Boundary zero-freeness fixes the finite zero multiset in the rectangle. Simple real roots continue as real roots; leaving the real axis would require a real multiple zero.
homotopy.theorem: H_t(z)=0 and |Re z|<=38 imply Im z=0 for every 0<=t<=1/5

sector_transfer.theorem: P_(d,n,t)(x)=sum_(j=0)^d binom(d,j)A_(n+j)(t)x^j is hyperbolic with real negative zeros for every 0<=d<=361, n>=0, and 0<=t<=1/5

rows.claim: Four theta summands plus an analytic geometric envelope enclose the exact Xi kernel.
rows.proof_boundary: The envelope is used only inside the directed boundary calculation.

rows.claim: A bivariate Taylor model encloses the real part on each rational parameter box.
rows.proof_boundary: Absolute positive moments enclose both Taylor remainders.

rows.claim: The vertical sides of the central zero rectangle are zero-free.
rows.proof_boundary: Evenness and conjugation give the side Re z=-38.

rows.formula: |Im z|<=sqrt(1-2t)<1 for t>0; H_0(z)=xi((1+iz)/2)/8 at t=0
rows.proof_boundary: The endpoint uses the classical zero-free lines Re s=0,1.

rows.claim: No real multiple zero occurs in the central band during the homotopy.
rows.proof_boundary: This imports the 1,900-box compact transversality certificate.

rows.claim: Every zero in the central real-width band is real.
rows.formula: H_t(z)=0 and |Re z|<=38 imply Im z=0
rows.proof_boundary: Boundary exclusion, top-time reality, and no real collision give the homotopy.

rows.claim: Every squared-variable zero lies in a narrow negative-axis sector.
rows.proof_boundary: Real central zeros map to the negative axis; nonreal zeros have |Re z|>38 and |Im z|<=1.

rows.claim: Chasse's sector theorem applies to F_t and all derivatives.
rows.proof_boundary: The order-one-half and positive-coefficient inputs are inherited from the degree-71 certificate.

rows.claim: Every shifted Xi Jensen polynomial through degree 361 is hyperbolic with negative zeros.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a finite-degree theorem and does not include degree 362.

rows.claim: The real-zero-band theorem strictly sharpens the prior zero-slab cutoff.
rows.proof_boundary: The earlier theorem remains an independent direct zero-slab proof.

rows.claim: No all-degree or Newman-bound conclusion follows from a finite sector cutoff.
rows.formula: degree 362, cofinal degrees, PF-infinity, Lambda<=0, and RH remain open
rows.proof_boundary: The next sector upgrade needs a wider certified real-zero band or an unbounded sequence.
